newsitem.title: USA: US crude hits contract high on ACCESS, upside seen.
newsitem.headline: US crude hits contract high on ACCESS, upside seen.

text.p: U.S. crude oil prices reached contract highs in after-hours trading on Thursday, and traders forecast further rallies on Friday.
November crude oil traded $24.86 a barrel by 2110 EDT/0110 GMT, five cents over settlement.
"I think we'll see contract highs tomorrow," one trader said. Early on ACCESS, crude set a contract high of $25.08 and resistance was seen at $25.35 and $25.70.
Traders said heating oil would continue higher on Friday, after settling up 2.71 cent at 74.69 cents. It traded 74.75 cents after-hours, off from its early ACCESS high of 75.05.
Meanwhile, gasoline drew strength from heating oil, edging up 0.06 cent to 74.69 cents after-hours.
